description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWRT build system, including image validation, upgrade execution, and configuration copying for specific hardware (gateworks, imx8m).

methods.name: enable_image_metadata_check
methods.description: Enables image metadata validation based on board type.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the current platform supports image upgrade.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the actual upgrade process for the platform.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration backup to the device's partition.
